subject: reasoning
question:
Select the Venn diagram that best illustrates the relationship between the given classes.

Rational numbers, Whole numbers, Real number
solution:
For this question, the relation of Rational numbers, Whole numbers, Real number is given below-

I) Every Whole number is a Rational number.

ii) All rational numbers are Real numbers.

Here, According to the above relation Venn diagram will be as-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/84a7ac8aac677777a30dbca8fc96b157636f29e8dcbdeeadb3a1753dfaf87430.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option (3)"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**Whole number: A whole number is **simply any positive number that does not include a fractional or decimal part.**

Rational number: A number that **can be represented as the quotient p/q of two integers such that q ≠ 0.**

Real number: Real numbers are **numbers that include both rational and irrational numbers.**
